# oodle_genai_dataset (Resource)

A named collection of GenAI evaluation inputs. Add rows with oodle_genai_dataset_item.

Datasets have no update endpoint, so every attribute forces replacement — and replacing a dataset deletes its items and run history. The resource is imported by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A dataset is a fixed set of inputs an experiment runs a prompt over.
#
# Datasets have no update endpoint, so changing any attribute replaces
# the dataset — which deletes its items and its run history.
resource "oodle_genai_dataset" "support_eval" {
  name        = "support-eval"
  description = "Questions from the support inbox, with reviewed answers."

  metadata = jsonencode({
    owner = "support-eng"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the dataset.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the dataset covers.
- `metadata` (String) JSON object of arbitrary metadata.

### Read-Only

- `dataset_id` (String) Server-assigned uuid of the dataset. Use this where an evaluator or experiment asks for a dataset id.
- `id` (String) Name of the dataset. Datasets are addressed by name rather than by uuid.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Datasets are imported by name, not by uuid.
terraform import oodle_genai_dataset.support_eval support-eval
```
